title: Multi-Role FLS & Export Redaction Dataflow Walkthrough
intro: Follow how active RolePermissions and UserGroup restrictions preserve dotted resource keys, merge across multiple roles, and govern UI masking and file exports uniformly.
outro: Both JSON API responses and CSV/XLSX/PDF exports enforce the exact same canonical dotted FLS and record scope rules.

points.title: Entitled Roles Normalized Cleanly
points.text: Active RolePermissions ordered by Priority 0 ascending enter PermissionResourceNormalizer, which preserves dotted keys such as crm.opportunities instead of truncating on Split('.')[0].
points.caption: Dotted resource keys survive normalization intact

points.title: Read-Preferred Intersect + Group Union
points.text: FieldLevelSecurityMergeHelper intersects masks across read-capable roles (so Manager + Rep unlocks Manager visibility) and unions additive UserGroup restrictions like GRP_SCRIPE_PII_MASKED on top.
points.caption: Permissive across roles, strict cap from UserGroups

points.title: Route & Record Visibility Alignment
points.text: The merged FLS map and effective scope feed both EndpointResourceResolver ([Resource] overrides / single PBAC inference) and ICrmRecordVisibilityPolicy with restriction aliases.
points.caption: Same merged context governs columns and rows

points.title: REST JSON Masking, Write Refusal & UI Scrubbing
points.text: JSON projection masks restricted DTO properties, write behaviors block restricted payload tampering with 403, and GenericCrudView omits or renders *** masks consistently.
points.caption: Read and write APIs + React UI enforce identical FLS

points.title: Export Redactor & Background DataTransfer Parity
points.text: Audit, Dashboard (requiring audit.export), CRM, Compliance (CsvFormulaGuard.Neutralize), and DataTransfer exports redact restricted columns and aliases before producing safe files.
points.caption: Zero sensitive leakage through spreadsheets or async exports
